notes.en:
• Reveal local output files in their containing folder. Repair Windows paths, special filenames and session workcopy references; missing or restricted paths show an explicit error.
• Keep Windows interface-format menus above the provider dialog. Website-managed models retain their authorized protocol.
• Keep Recharge, Refresh and Sign out on one aligned row, moving the complete group below the description in narrow layouts.
• Preserve accounts, billing, API configurations, personal model parameters and sessions. Installation remains manual; the API backend is unchanged.
notes.zh-CN:
• 点击对话中的本地输出文件，默认在文件所在文件夹中定位；修复 Windows 路径、中文和特殊文件名、独立工作副本下的链接。文件不存在或超出允许目录时显示明确提示。
• 修复 Windows 自行添加的 AI 服务中，接口格式菜单被弹窗遮挡的问题。网站管理的模型继续使用网站授权的接口协议。
• “充值、刷新账号、退出登录”保持一行；窄布局下整组移到说明文字下方。
• 保留原有账号、计费、API 配置、个人模型参数和会话。更新仍需手动安装，本次不更换 API 网站后端。
